source: NBR 6118:2014: the ultimate section strength by design strengths fcd = fck/1.4, fyd = fyk/1.15 with the rectangular block 0.85 fcd over 0.8 x; one-way shear by model I (θ = 45°: Vc0 = 0.6 fctd bw d = 0.09 fck^(2/3) bw d, VRd2 = 0.27 (1 - fck/250) fcd bw d, the stirrups on 0.9 d with fywd ≤ 435 MPa) by the generic tabulatedStress method. The project's concrete fc is read as fck. Torsion, punching, deflection, cracking, cover, anchorage, columns' second order, slabs, walls and footings take the base pack's ACI 318-19 methods (VERIFY.md B22). Model II (variable θ 30°-45°) is not set.
